entities.summary: Daniele Libanori is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who is an official of the Roman Curia as Pope Francis' supervisor of Consecrated Life. He was a Auxiliary Bishop of Rome from 2018 to 2024. He began his career with several years as a parish priest and a decade as rector of the seminary of the Archdiocese of Ferrara. He joined the Jesuits in 1991 and worked as a university chaplain and then as the rector of parishes in Rome until becoming a bishop in 2018.
